method: For each paired stage_finished, interval=[monotonic_s-duration_s,monotonic_s]. Subtract the clipped union of completed direct-child intervals from the reported inclusive duration. Direct-child intervals already include their descendants. Same-process only; stage_finish within the physical-window host-wall boundaries; this is a measured-stage accounting estimate including monitor boundary/recording overhead, not an exact profiler attribution to code lines. Uninstrumented residual work is not identified as DB/JSON/checkpoint-only work.
